author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 논, 밭, 습지, 하천, 하구 삼각주
summary: 비교적 흔한 겨울철새로, 중부 이남의 논, 밭, 습지, 하천, 하구 삼각주 등에 찾아온다. 곤충, 지렁이, 씨와 열매를 먹는다. 둥지는 풀밭 땅 위를 오목하게 파서 접시 모양으로 만든다. 국외에서는 유라시아, 아프리카 서부, 중국 남부에 분포한다.

art.subject: Northern Lapwing (Vanellus vanellus), adult in breeding plumage: black forehead, crown and nape glossed green, with nape feathers raised into an upswept crest; white supercilium from the bill base over the eye; broad black breast band glossed blue; black scapulars, back and rump glossed green with a purple sheen in some light; white lower breast, belly and flanks; deep rusty-red uppertail coverts; brownish apricot legs
art.pose: standing in a field, picking insects and worms from the ground
art.scene: Korean winter rice paddies and wet fields near a river; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: green-glossed black crown with upswept crest, white supercilium, broad black breast band, glossy black back, white belly, brownish apricot legs
adult, rear view: deep rusty-red uppertail coverts
